9-19-2000 Order PSC-00-1675-PAA-WS  9-19-00 approves transfer of  certificates 277-W and 223-S in Seminole County from Alafaya Palm Valley Associates, Ltd. (WS509) to CWS Communities LP d/b/a Palm Valley (WS832). 

11-27-00 Order PSC-00-2243-PAA-WS 11-27-00 amends certificates  277-W and 223-S to include additional territory in Seminole  County as listed in order. 

02/28/2001 Update Request letter mailed. 
02/20/2002 Update Request letter mailed. 

7-29-2002 Order PSC-02-1029-FOF-WS 7-29-02 approves transfer of  majority organizational control as stated in order. 

02/19/2003 Update Request letter mailed. 
02/23/2004 Update Request letter mailed. 

11-23-2004 Order PSC-04-1169-FOF-WS 11-23-04 approves name change on certificates 223-S and 277-W from CWS Communities LP d/b/a  Palm Valley to CWS Communities LP d/b/a Palm Valley Utilities  effective 11-23-04. 

2-17-2005 Order PSC-05-0186-PAA-WS 2-17-05 approves transfer of   majority organizational control of Del Tura Phase I  d/b/a Del   Tura Utilities (SU315), CWS Communities LP d/b/a Palm Valley   Utilities (WS832) and CWS Communities LP (WU839) from Chateau   Communities, Inc. to Hometown America, LLC as stated in order, effective 10-16-03. 

02/24/2005 Update Request letter mailed. 

4-20-2005 Order PSC-05-0425-FOF-WS 4-20-05 approves amendments to certificates 223-S and 277-W for deletions and amendments to  portions of service territory in Seminole county as listed in  order. 

02/21/2006 Update Request letter mailed. 
02/23/2007 Update Request letter mailed. 
02/20/2008 Update Request letter mailed. 
02/13/2009 Update Request letter mailed. 
02/10/2010 Update Request letter mailed. 
02/14/2011 Update Request letter mailed. 

5/13/2021 - Change of Regulated Utility Contact Information No. 331 rcvd; information updated on 5/14/21. -dm
 
4/19/2023 - Final Order PSC-2023-0137-FOF-WS approves name change from CWS Communities LP d/b/a Palm Valley Utilities to Hometown Palm Valley, LLC d/b/a Palm Valley Utilities on Certificate Nos. 277-W and 223-S, effective on the date of order. (DN 02773-2023) -dm
